strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_normal.text: Tax season brought no surprises. The X-date estimates barely move.
strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_normal.title: April receipts in line with forecasts
strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_strong.text: Tax payments came in well above what the Treasury expected. The X-date moves later, by a few weeks if it holds.
strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_strong.title: April receipts beat forecasts
strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_weak.text: Tax payments came in well below forecasts. The Treasury warns the X-date may come weeks sooner than thought.
strings.event.usa.tax_receipts_weak.title: April receipts fall short

strings.scenario.xdate.ending.dealmaker.text: You got a deal done and paid a fair price for it. Not everyone is happy, which is how you know it was a deal.
strings.scenario.xdate.ending.default.text: The United States stopped paying its bondholders. Whatever came next, it began here.
strings.scenario.xdate.ending.pyrrhic.text: The country did not default, but the cost was high: allies bruised, markets wary, your standing worn down.
strings.scenario.xdate.ending.removed.text: Congress removed you from office before the crisis was over.
strings.scenario.xdate.ending.statesman.text: You turned a crisis into a governing win. Markets calmed, your coalition held, and the country noticed.
strings.scenario.xdate.ending.survivor.text: The bills got paid and you are still standing. It was not pretty, and the next fight is already on the calendar.
For a few days the United States did not pay what it owed. It was made good quickly, but the record is permanent.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.approval.desc: Your approval at the end against where it started. Each point gained or lost moves this part of the score.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.approval.hint: Avoid a default and a market panic, keep prices and jobs steady, and watch the polling average on Public. Single polls are noisy: judge by the trend.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.coalition.desc: How much the factions of your own party support you at the end, less a penalty if a primary challenger is floated or launched.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.coalition.hint: Their support can't be measured directly: read their public signals on Factions, keep their priorities in your bills, and spend favours where the whip count is short.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.economy.desc: The average of four changes since the start: the 10-year yield, the stock market, unemployment, and how far inflation is from the Fed's target.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.economy.hint: A long standoff raises yields and shakes markets even without a default. A clean, early deal is worth more than a perfect one late.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.fiscal.desc: The deficit as a share of GDP at the end against the start: lower is better.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.fiscal.hint: Spending cuts and revenue in the deal improve it; sweeteners added to win votes cost it.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.institutions.desc: The health of the country's institutions: the regime indicators that norm-breaking orders wear down.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.institutions.hint: Lawful orders cost nothing here. Unlawful and manifestly unlawful ones, and ignoring courts, cost the most.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.midterms.desc: How many House seats your party is projected to win or lose at the midterms, against the projection at the start.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.midterms.hint: It follows approval and the economy. Fights inside your own party and a primary challenge cost seats.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.no_default.desc: Every bondholder is paid on time until the campaign ends. A missed payment made up within days is a technical default: you survive it, but it costs 12 points off the final score, which then can't exceed 44. A real default ends the campaign.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.no_default.hint: Raise or suspend the debt limit before the X-date. Watch the estimates on Intel: the Treasury's range is the one to trust, and it moves with tax receipts.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.stay_in_office.desc: You are still president when the campaign ends: no removal under the 25th Amendment, no impeachment conviction.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.stay_in_office.hint: Orders that break the law or norms can turn your own cabinet and party against you. Counsel's verdict on the command desk tells you how far you are pushing.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.world.desc: The average opinion foreign leaders hold of the United States at the end against the start.
strings.scenario.xdate.goal.world.hint: A default or a near-miss alarms creditors such as Japan and China. Talks and reassurance on World help.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.acquitted: The House impeached you; the Senate acquitted.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.challenger: A primary challenger is running against you.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.challenger_floated: Your own party's base floated a primary challenger.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.default: Bondholders went unpaid for {days} days and were not made whole in time. The United States defaulted.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.inquiry: The House opened an impeachment inquiry.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.prioritized: For {days} days the Treasury paid bondholders first while benefit checks and contractors waited.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.seats_gain: Your party is projected to gain {seats} House seats in November.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.seats_loss: Your party is projected to lose {seats} House seats in November.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.shutdown: The government was shut down for {days} days.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.technical_default: Bondholders went unpaid for {days} days before the limit was fixed: a technical default, permanently on the record.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.xdate_avoided: The Treasury never ran out of room: the limit was dealt with before the X-date.
strings.scenario.xdate.recap.xdate_reached: The Treasury ran out of room on {date}.
strings.ui.desk.body: Congress passed {title} ({sponsor}'s bill). You have ten days to sign or veto it; if you do neither, it becomes law.
strings.ui.desk.override_likely: Both chambers passed it by two thirds or more: a veto would probably be overridden.
strings.ui.desk.override_unlikely: It passed without two thirds somewhere: a veto would probably stand.
strings.ui.desk.title: On your desk: {title}
